arguments.value: Phoenix Satellite Television Company Limited and Beijing Tianying Jiuzhou Network Technology Co., Ltd. entered into a Program Content License Agreement. Phoenix Satellite TV licensed Beijing Tianying Jiuzhou Network Technology the right to use specified Phoenix program content listed in the agreement’s exhibit, as updated from time to time, only for Beijing Tianying’s authorized business involving the Phoenix Satellite TV Websites and Other Websites and related services. Beijing Tianying was not given any copyright or other intellectual property rights in the program content, had to keep Phoenix’s business secrets confidential, and could not use, disclose, or sublicense the content outside the agreement without Phoenix’s written consent. The parties agreed that fees would be handled under a related agreement referenced in the source, and they also could agree separately on fees for additional services beyond this agreement. The agreement became effective when signed and sealed and lasted five years, with any extension only if Phoenix confirmed in writing before expiration and both sides later agreed. The governing law is PRC Law, and disputes must first be negotiated and, if unresolved after 30 business days, arbitrated in Hong Kong by the Hong Kong International Arbitration Centre in English.
